cohort: age >=18; first ICU stay per patient; all ICU stays count-only sensitivity
pair_anchor: each cuff MAP reading; median of arterial MAP within symmetric window
signal_allowed: unstratified cuff MAP >=65 among arterial MAP <65; patient-cluster 95% CI

eicu_interval_rule.evidence_type: inferred infusion period; not directly recorded start/end

implementation_details.bp_same_time_components: Use same modality and family at exact recorded time; median exact duplicates. Reject each observed artifact criterion; missing SBP/DBP are unknown for those checks and reported separately, not automatically abnormal.
implementation_details.pair_arterial_window: Cuff anchor must be inside treatment episode. Arterial measurements must be in the same treatment episode; deduplicate identical time within modality, then median valid MAP values in each window.
implementation_details.time_difference: For each cuff with any arterial value within 10 min, report nearest absolute source time difference; median-window MAP has no single source timestamp. Same-minute fraction uses floor(source_time/minute).
implementation_details.dose_during_bridged_gap: Coverage can bridge gap <=60/30 min; do not invent an infusion rate during a direct-record gap. NE-eq is unknown unless active source dose records cover that anchor. Build continuity episodes for each drug; if ANY expected constituent is in an undocumented gap or has unconvertible dose, TOTAL NE-eq is unknown even when other drugs have known active rates.
implementation_details.bmi: Use admission or earliest clinically recorded height/weight, not per-infusion patientweight. Interval-valued Amsterdam BMI is a midpoint proxy and separately reports definite/possible BMI>40 bounds.
implementation_details.af: Rhythm observation anywhere during eligible ICU stay; any positive AF record overrides other rhythms. Only if no usable rhythm charting, use diagnosis fallback. Counts describe patients, not contemporaneous AF exposure.
implementation_details.cluster_ci: Patient-level bootstrap percentile 95% CI, 2000 replicates, seed=20261027. Patients sampled without replacement at ceil(10% of primary paired patients); resample all selected patient clusters including zero low-MAP denominators.
implementation_details.first_stay_eicu: Earliest hospitaldischargeyear; only a unique hospitalization in that year can establish ordering. Within that hospitalization earliest ICU start by hospitaladmitoffset, then unitvisitnumber. Same-year multiple-hospitalization order unknown: exclude from first-stay primary, retain all-stay count sensitivity.; hospitaladmitoffset DESC (earliest ICU start), never ascending.
implementation_details.first_stay_amsterdam: Identify earliest admission containing IC per patient, then primary only if location=IC. Earlier mixed IC/MC with unlocatable conversion makes first ICU unknown; pure MC excluded. All locations reported.
implementation_details.first_stay_sicdb: Map complete unit dictionary; use unitlog to identify cases with any ICU. Earliest such case by OffsetAfterFirstAdmission + ICUOffset is primary only when all recorded units are ICU; mixed/unknown first cases excluded and reported. No ICU/MC assumption from cases.HospitalUnit alone.
implementation_details.bootstrap_scope: Never calculate stratified agreement or associate mortality/AKI with exposures.
implementation_details.mimic_height_correction: Closest valid height linked to the same ICU stay, including charttime before ICU intime; inches converted to cm. Correction after missingness red flag, logged D007.
implementation_details.sicdb_weight: Released WeightOnAdmission is grams; divide by 1000 to kg before BMI and mass/kg dosing. Corrected after preliminary results, D008.
implementation_details.sicdb_af: Main diagnosis only; explicit AF I48.0/.1/.2 or unambiguous AF text. I48 and I48.9 represent AF/flutter ambiguity and are not confirmed AF.
implementation_details.mimic_care_scope: Primary uses source icustays as provided, not proven pure ICU at every time. Post-result bounded transfers probe recorded D011; original main counts unchanged.
